records.channel: The People Behind History's Greatest Turning Points
records.youtube_title: Napoleon's Fatal Gamble: Why He Invaded Russia in 1812
records.youtube_description: Why did Napoleon march into Russia? An archival-inspired paper-cut documentary exploring the decision and its tragic consequences. Illustrations are artistic reconstructions, not authentic archival footage.
records.central_question: Why did Napoleon expect Russia to negotiate?
records.historical_thesis: The 1812 invasion seriously weakened Napoleon's forces; the collapse of the empire followed further campaigns in 1813–1814.
